chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:

Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام was asked about a woman whose husband was afflicted in his mind after he married her, or insanity befell him. He said: "She has the right to separate herself from him if she wishes."

key_terms.أَبُو إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abu Ibrahim, a title of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far al-Kadhim عليه السلام
key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَتْ: if she wishes, indicating her choice
key_terms.تَنْزِعَ نَفْسَهَا: to remove herself, meaning to separate herself from the marriage
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman in question within the marriage ruling

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have the right to separate from her husband if he becomes insane after marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman whose husband loses his sanity after marriage. Imam Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام states that she may separate herself from him if she chooses, indicating her recognized right in such a circumstance.
